description: This file defines a PHP class 'HTML' within the Opencart admin extension module namespace. The class extends a system Controller and handles rendering a configuration page for an HTML module, along with save, add, and delete actions, involving interactions with models, language packs, and response output.

classes.name: HTML
classes.description: Controller class for managing an HTML module in OpenCart's admin interface, including rendering configuration pages and performing CRUD operations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the HTML module configuration page, setting up breadcrumbs, loading module info, languages, and partial views.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving updated module data via POST, with permission checks and validation, responds with JSON.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new HTML module, after permission check, responds with JSON including success message.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified module if permitted, responds with JSON indicating success or error.
